claims: Check if the earphone jack is fully inserted into the phone port.
Clean any dust or lint out of the phone's audio jack or charging port.
Test the earphones on another device to see if the issue is with the phone or the earphones.

claims.text: Check if both sides work by trying the headphones on another phone or laptop.
Check your phone's sound or accessibility settings to ensure the left-right balance is in the middle and mono audio is off.
Restart your phone and try again.
